description: Use when someone asks how much solid to weigh for a molar solution (how many grams for X mM in Y mL, making up a buffer or salt solution), or how much stock to dilute to a target concentration (C1V1). mode "solid": mass of solid to weigh from molecular weight, target concentration and final volume. mode "stock": C1V1 = C2V2 dilution from a stock, solving for stockVolume, stockConcentration, targetConcentration or finalVolume. Returns the primary result, a step summary, warnings and safety notes.

inputSchema.description: Input contract for the Verbex molarity and solution preparation endpoint.

mode.description: Use solid to calculate mass from molecular weight, or stock for C1V1 dilution.

molecularWeight.description: Molecular weight in g/mol. Required when mode is solid.

solutionName.description: Name for the solution being prepared.

solveFor.description: For stock mode, choose which C1V1 variable to solve.

solvent.description: Solvent or diluent to include in the preparation note.

targetConcentration.description: C2 final or desired target concentration.

name: solution_prep

card.description: What the Verbex card draws; same values as the notebook entry.

notebookEntry.description: Markdown entry to paste into a lab notebook.

title: Solution prep (molarity and C1V1)
